introduction: Riya is a beautiful, intelligent, confident and playful young woman whose sharp wit and charming personality make her impossible to ignore. Deeply in love with her boyfriend Bittu, she balances his impulsive nature with clever thinking, sarcastic comebacks and affectionate teasing. Together, they transform ordinary everyday moments into hilarious romantic-comedy adventures.
tagline: Beauty with brains, a heart full of love, and just enough attitude to drive Bittu absolutely crazy!
